baseline_configuration.description: Demonstration DES Y3 NLA joint xi± + Map3 Fisher forecast with w0 and wa, all 480 public rows and recorded source clipping.
notes: Demonstration forecast with explicit source clipping and normalization; not a reproduction of a published posterior.
Keep all 400 xi and 80 Map3 rows and every cross-covariance entry; no implicit scale cuts or MOPED.
The published covariance applies an approximately 8 arcmin lower cut to BOTH measured SAS side parameters. Its aperture radii remain 7,14,25,40 arcmin.
The explicit 8-to-80 arcmin, 10-side-bin, 63-angle-bin model below is a design approximation; exact retained measurement edges, bin averaging and emulator equivalence require validation.
The public covariance is reused at fixed cosmology and NLA physics while the mean uses NLA. Connected IA covariance changes are omitted.
All 400 xi rows include scales removed by the published two-point cuts. No claim of baryon robustness is valid before an explicit cut/model study.
IA Table 1 fiducial choices follow2601.09133; source curves/covariance follow the public Y3 simulation files. This is deliberately a new mixed-input forecast.
power_mode=2 means nonlinear P(k,z) in quadratic three-point IA. Compare mode0 and historical mode1 as distinct physical prescriptions.
Photo-z and calibration Gaussian widths follow2503.03964 Table3. No Gaussian prior is inferred from a uniform parameter range.
Velocity shear ct and bispectrum-only feedback fb are fixed to zero because the chosen two-point model has no corresponding complete joint response.
BiHalofit and effective-growth neutrino approximations remain; mnu is fixed rather than forecast.
Numerical grids are starting choices. Refine transforms, projection, CFASTPT, ell quadrature and derivative steps separately before interpreting errors.
This reduced NLA run fixes a2,bta,eta2 and removes their derivative columns; it is conditional on the simpler IA model.

FITS clipping and normalization are recorded in runs/y3_demo_sources.json; original upstream FITS bytes remain unchanged. The physical NPZ metadata separately records the PCHIP reconstruction, measured edges and numerical sampling.

Sources use measured-edge PCHIP with 9601 samples, 401 kernel nodes and 129 LOS nodes. This is a declared reconstruction model, not a recalibrated source distribution or a guarantee of bin-probability preservation.
The source and radial refinements are measured in tests/studies/source_policy_validation.md. Retain h and h/2 as the principal step check; a still smaller step was not uniformly better.
w0 and wa are varied without Gaussian priors. Their FoM is a numerical accuracy diagnostic beyond the fixed-dark-energy paper analyses.

reuse_study_provenance.interpretation: Only Omega_m and Hubble h columns are replaced in the fixed full Delta/2 Fisher. These are step diagnostics, not full new forecasts.

summary.interpretation: Dark energy fixed at the saved fiducial; every other varied parameter marginalized; saved Gaussian prior counted once.
